descriptions.text:
Order is born from calculation; this was the truth that allowed the great Yu to rule.
Inspired by the ancient Zhoubi Suanjing classic, the master swordsman Li Chunfeng grasped the "Principle of Compounding Forms." He saw that behind infinite variations lay a single, constant truth.
From this, he derived a myriad of sword techniques. And among them, one became known in the jianghu as the Sword of Strategy.

When a Special Skill hits an enemy, if the target is under 5 stacks of Bleed, it clears all Bleed and immediately deals High Bleed damage once, and restores 10 Endurance. The Endurance restoration effect can only be triggered once per target per cast.
Affinity Rate increases by 0.0152 percentage points per Power, up to 4.256% at 280 Power.
When calculating Bleed damage, further increases Physical Penetration and Bellstrike Penetration based on Max Physical Attack, up to 15 points increase at 1500 Max Physical Attack.

Increases Bellstrike Attack by 98-196.
Bellstrike Penetration increases by 0.0336 per Max Bellstrike Attack, up to 22 at ≈654.762 Max Bellstrike Attack.
All skills deal damage based on Attribute Attack, while Bellstrike Attack deals 50% bonus damage.

Your adoptive father Jiang Wulang called himself a hermit of the wilds, yet he knew the jianghu like the back of his hand.
His swordsmanship, passed down through countless days of practice, has gradually opened your eyes to a realm beyond the ordinary.

Increases Qi damage dealt by 10% and the Sword Energy attack's Qi damage dealt to players and HP damage to non-player units by 2% for every 100 Max Physical Attack, up to 20% increase at 1000 Max Physical Attack.
Max Physical Attack increases by 0.264 per Momentum, up to 73.92 at 280 Momentum.

Increases the Affinity DMG of Sword Energy waves against targets with Qi below 40% (including Exhausted targets) or in the Qi Imbalance state based on Max Physical Attack, up to 18.0% increase at 1500 Max Physical Attack.

Increases Bellstrike Attack by 98-196.
Bellstrike Penetration increases by 0.0336 per Max Bellstrike Attack, up to 22 at ≈654.762 Max Bellstrike Attack.
All skills deal damage based on Attribute Attack, while Bellstrike Attack deals 50% bonus damage.

The signature art of the Raging Tides' Sect Master Shi Jiuge, the spear is famed for its awe-inspiring might.
Each thrust is said to shake the very heavens—unstoppable, overwhelming, and leaving no room for retreat. Its sweeping strokes crash down with the force of a tempest, carrying a righteous momentum that shatters all before it, hence the name Heavenquaker Spear.

Heavenquaker Spear Charged Skills apply 1 stack of Soul-Shaken: increases all DoT damage taken by 5%, with an additional 5% if the source is using Strategic Sword or Heavenquaker Spear. Lasts 18s and stacks up to 5 times. Each stack also increases High Bleeding damage taken by 10%.
Max Physical Attack increases by 0.264 per Power, up to 73.92 at 280 Power.
Increases Affinity DMG from DoT and its empowered effects based on Max Physical Attack, up to 18.00% increase at 1500 Max Physical Attack.

Increases Bellstrike Attack by 98-196.
Bellstrike DMG Bonus increases by 0.0168 percentage points per Max Bellstrike Attack, up to 11% at ≈654.762 Max Bellstrike Attack.
All skills deal damage based on Attribute Attack, while Bellstrike Attack deals 50% bonus damage.

Shi Jiuge's legendary spear technique is bold as thunder, its movements straightforward yet devastating.
Each thrust channels the raw fury of storms, and though its basics seem simple, true mastery makes heaven and earth tremble.
Increases Max Endurance by 10. When Endurance is below 30%, increases Endurance Recovery by 20%. For every 2% Affinity Rate over 10%, further increases Endurance by 1, up to 10 at 30% Affinity Rate.
Affinity Rate increases by 0.0152 percentage points per Momentum, up to 4.256% at 280 Momentum.
When you have Endless Gale or Endurance is below 60%, increases Affinity DMG based on Affinity Rate, up to 18% increase at 30% Affinity Rate.

Increases Bellstrike Attack by 98-196.
Bellstrike DMG Bonus increases by 0.0168 percentage points per Max Bellstrike Attack, up to 11% at ≈654.762 Max Bellstrike Attack.

"Beneath drifting willows along the Yellow Flower River, wisdom flows as surely as the Silver Needle follows its patient's pulse."
Sun Yuan's medical tome, gifted by Master Moonstream, became his life's work, shared with healers when the Sun family went into seclusion.
Enriched by famed physicians' notes, this nameless book evolved into the foundation of the Silver Needle Sect, and the essence of the Panacea Fan technique.
Restores 2 bonus Dew per second when you are within the range of a water clone you created. Increases the water clone's healing to allies with HP below 30% by 50%.
Critical Rate increases by 0.0304 percentage points per Agility, up to 8.512% at 280 Agility.
Increases Heavy Attack's healing by 5.0%, and further increases it based on Min Physical Attack, up to 25.00% increase at 750 Min Physical Attack.

Increases Silkbind Attack by 98-196.
Silkbind DMG Bonus and Silkbind Healing Bonus increases by 0.0336 percentage points per Min Silkbind Attack, up to 11% at ≈327.381 Min Silkbind Attack.
Deals bonus healing based on Silkbind Attack. All skills deal damage based on Attribute Attack, while Silkbind Attack deals 50% bonus damage.

Rivers flow beyond the realm of earth, and mountain hues shimmer between presence and absence. Sun Yuan once gazed upon the Scenic Scroll of the Three Hundred Miles of Jialing River. Inspired, he climbed to a high peak. In a moment of exhilaration, he wielded his fan with the flourish of splattered ink, as if painting with the mountains themselves, each stroke unstoppable, like a living landscape. But once the trance faded, he could never use that fan technique again.
Ten years passed. A bell chimed in the clouds. And in that instant, Sun Yuan recalled the feeling, and the Inkwell Fan resurfaced in the jianghu once more.
Against targets with below 30% Qi, increases Heavy Attack Pursuit Moon Shatter Spring's Critical Rate by 30% and HP damage by 8%. When dealing Critical DMG, each hit deals an additional 5 Qi damage.
Min Physical Attack increases by 0.264 per Agility, up to 73.92 at 280 Agility.
Increases the Critical DMG of Heavy Attack Pursuit Moon Shatter Spring by 2.4% for every 50 Min Physical Attack, up to 36% increase at 750 Min Physical Attack.

Increases Silkbind Attack by 98-196.
Silkbind DMG Bonus increases by 0.0336 percentage points per Min Silkbind Attack, up to 11% at ≈327.381 Min Silkbind Attack.

Each thrust channels the raw fury of storms, and though its basics seem simple, true mastery makes heaven and earth tremble.
Increases Max Battle Will by one bar. Further increases it by 1 bar when Max HP reaches 50000.
Max HP increases by 10 per the higher of Body or Power, up to 2800 at 280 the higher of Body or Power.
Within 3 seconds after hitting Charged Skills and their Varied Combos, reduces 2% Physical Damage taken for every 6,000 Max HP, up to 30% reduction at 90000 Max HP.

Increases Stonesplit Attack by 98-196.
Stonesplit DMG Bonus increases by 0.0336 percentage points per Min Stonesplit Attack, up to 11% at ≈327.381 Min Stonesplit Attack.

Ju Meng spent a fortune collecting the greatest blade styles across the land, ultimately mastering and merging them into a single, unparalleled art.
When General Zhou Yafu witnessed it, he was so astonished that he cried out seven thunderous praises: "By thunder! This blade roars like a storm!" Inspired, Ju Meng named it the Thundercry Blade.

Thundercry Blade's Charged Skill and Varied Combo will never become Abrasion and deal 10% more Critical DMG. Increases the Max Physical Attack used in calculating the damage by 4 for every 5,000 Max HP, up to 120 Max Physical Attack at 150000 Max HP.
Max Physical Attack increases by 0.264 per the higher of Body or Power, up to 73.92 at 280 the higher of Body or Power.
Increases the Critical Rate of Thundercry Blade's Charged Skill and related Varied Combo by 9%. For every 6,000 Max HP, further increases their Critical Rate by 1%, up to 15% at 90000 Max HP.

Increases Stonesplit Attack by 98-196.
Stonesplit Penetration increases by 0.0672 per Min Stonesplit Attack, up to 22 at ≈327.381 Min Stonesplit Attack.
All skills deal damage based on Attribute Attack, while Stonesplit Attack deals 50% bonus damage.

Forged by Zhang Huaishen, this art is the sacred charge of the Raging Tides disciples. More than a martial style, it is a solemn vow passed through generations, born of two legendary spirits: the unwavering valor of the Anxi Army, lonely guardians of the frontier, and the defiant resolve of the Guyi Army, protectors of the people. Their blood is their oath; their devotion, eternal.
Increases maximum Blade Momentum by 2 bars. When Anxi Soldier deals damage, gain 0.1 bar of Blade Momentum. This effect can trigger up to 4 times per second.
Critical Rate increases by 0.0304 percentage points per Agility, up to 8.512% at 280 Agility.

When calculating damage during the Iron Guards state, further increases Physical Penetration and Stonesplit Penetration based on Min Physical Attack, up to 12 points increase at 750 Min Physical Attack.

Stonesplit Penetration increases by 0.0672 per Min Stonesplit Attack, up to 22 at ≈327.381 Min Stonesplit Attack.

After the Huichang Persecution, Monk Liaowu dreamed of the Three Realms burning in endless fire. He saw suffering crush all souls, even Buddha's mercy powerless against it. The stains of greed, hatred, and ignorance clung like mire. Thus, he vowed to cross the world's sorrows, founding the Path of Rebirth.
Those who practice it must cast themselves into the darkest depths of Naraka, bearing the weight of karma alone—Infernal Twinblades that cut through sin's weight, purging karma with every strike to guide lost souls to bliss.

Slightly extends Perfect Dodge's trigger window. After triggering a Perfect Dodge, increases the breath-hold duration and resets the cooldown of Martial Art Skill, Addled Mind. Also increases the duration of any buffs gained from Perfect Dodge by 40%. This effect can only trigger once every 30s.
Min Physical Attack increases by 0.264 per Agility, up to 73.92 at 280 Agility.
Increases the Critical DMG Bonus during Flamelash by 5%, and further increases this bonus based on Min Physical Attack, up to 25.00% increase at 750 Min Physical Attack.

Casting Hero's Blood grants you Carouse for 20s, increasing Binge Points gained from Whaledraft. During Inebriate - Deepdaze, damage dealt by Dragonquench - Inebriate and Hero's Blood - Inebriate cannot trigger Abrasion.
Critical Rate increases by 0.0304 percentage points per Agility, up to 8.512% at 280 Agility.
During the Inebriate state, Physical Damage and Bamboocut Damage dealt scale with Min Physical Attack, up to 9% bonus at 750.

Velvet Shade was created by the founding master, Song Ruyan, who derived its form from the flowing dances of crimson blossoms.
With phoenix song and luan dance as its foundation, and exquisite thought as its core, she transformed herself—from a withered petal in the mud, from a helpless fish on the block—into a being far beyond the reach of the common world.
Since then, a thousand blooms remain unfading, spring rises to its ninth height, and the charm of wind and moon stretches on without end.

All ballistic skills ignore 5 Physical Resistance. If the target is immobilized or airborne, ignore 15 Physical Resistance. Unfading Flower refunds 3 Blossoms upon hitting an immobilized or airborne non-boss, or an exhausted boss.
Critical Rate increases by 0.0304 percentage points per Agility, up to 8.512% at 280 Agility.
Increases the Critical DMG of all Vernal Umbrella ballistic skills by 2.4% for every 50 Min Physical Attack, up to 36% increase at 750 Min Physical Attack.

Increases Silkbind Attack by 98-196.
Silkbind Penetration increases by 0.0672 per Min Silkbind Attack, up to 22 at ≈327.381 Min Silkbind Attack.

Driven by grief for his sister Jiang Fengwan and the vale's dying cocoons, Master Jiang Meiyan forged a mystical gu poison: blending his frozen blood with rare valley blooms.
When completed, its perfume revived withered flowers and drew lingering souls like moths to flame. The name Soulshade echoes its dual nature: its petals, like a sheltering umbrella, cradle wandering souls with the scent of renewal, guiding lost spirits back to life.

Martial Art Skill additionally grants yourself and allies an effect that deals 5% bonus damage to Exhausted targets, lasting 5 seconds, and also grants yourself and allies Tenacity for 5 seconds. Tenacity can only be applied once every 60 seconds, and each Wanderer can only receive Tenacity once from any source of Soulshade Umbrella talent every 60 seconds. When both Soulshade Umbrella and Panacea Fan are deployed, Mystic Skills deal 20% increased damage.
Min Physical Attack increases by 0.264 per Agility, up to 73.92 at 280 Agility.
Increases the Critical Healing Bonus of Special Skills by 5.0%, and further increases it based on Min Physical Attack, up to 25.00% increase at 750 Min Physical Attack.

Increases Silkbind Attack by 98-196.
Silkbind Penetration increases by 0.0672 per Min Silkbind Attack, up to 22 at ≈327.381 Min Silkbind Attack.
Deals bonus healing based on Silkbind Attack. All skills deal damage based on Attribute Attack, while Silkbind Attack deals 50% bonus damage.

Legend tells that in a drunken dream, Ehuang walked through a garden with a friend. As spring drew to its close, her friend wept for the fading beauty. To console her, Ehuang created this art, weaving into its forms the last crimson petals, the lingering scent of blossoms in the air, and the gentle spring breeze itself. Though the season must pass, within these movements, spring is eternal.

While Martial Art Skill Scarlet Spin is active, throw the umbrella again the moment it returns to your hand to trigger a Perfect Catch: Enhances the returning umbrella and increases Tenacity Damage dealt. Triggering a Perfect Catch grants 1 stack of Falling Blossoms for 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, Falling Blossoms transforms into 1-use Fragrant Song: The next Martial Art Skill's spinning umbrella flies 30% faster and is guaranteed to be a Critical Hit, and it deals 20% more HP damage to non-player units. Pressing the skill again during this accelerated flight guarantees a Perfect Catch.
Min Physical Attack increases by 0.264 per Agility, up to 73.92 at 280 Agility.
Increases the Physical Damage and Bamboocut Damage dealt by Martial Art Skill's returning umbrella based on Min Physical Attack, up to 12% bonus at 750 Min Physical Attack.

Increases Bamboocut Attack by 98-196.
Bamboocut Penetration increases by 0.0672 per Min Bamboocut Attack, up to 22 at ≈327.381 Min Bamboocut Attack.
All skills deal damage based on Attribute Attack, while Bamboocut Attack deals 50% bonus damage.

During the Khitan battle, Zhu Yousheng led unlettered youths, defenseless and adrift. In desperation, he adapted Ghost Valley Martial Arts, blending the Five Animal Poses and Seven Street Plays into the Nine Mortal Ways.
He saw common folk as seeds adrift, weightless yet resilient, carried by fate. Thus was born the Mortal Rope Dart: a weapon born from ordinary roots, weaving through the dust and currents of the mortal world.

Martial Art Skill Bladebound Thread and Varied Combo Coiled Dragon apply Bone Corrosion to the enemy for 5 seconds. Targets with Bone Corrosion take 5% increased Qi Damage from the applier, raising it to 40% for Light Attacks.
Critical Rate increases by 0.0304 percentage points per Agility, up to 8.512% at 280 Agility.
Increases the Physical Damage and Bamboocut damage of the rodents by 9%, and further increases it based on Min Physical Attack, up to 12.00% increase at 750 Min Physical Attack.

Increases Bamboocut Attack by 98-196.
Bamboocut DMG Bonus increases by 0.0336 percentage points per Min Bamboocut Attack, up to 11% at ≈327.381 Min Bamboocut Attack.

In a world of chaos, Zhu Yousheng saw the plight of the common folk. He saw them not as insignificant, but as mortal seeds: adrift, yet resilient. He knew the unspoken hardship of being nameless amid life's storms. His one wish was for these scattered souls to find strength in each other, a community to call their own. The Unfettered Rope Dart was born from this wish: a martial art for the rootless, so that even the most humble might one day soar, truly unfettered, like dragons among the clouds.

Each Token of Gratitude increases the max combo count of Piercing Dart by one, up to 7 sweeping attacks at 2 Tokens of Gratitude. Hitting an enemy with Charged Skill's sweeping attack reduces the cooldown of Martial Art Skill Soul Sweep by 0.5 seconds and restores 10 Tokens of Gratitude. This effect can only trigger once every 0.5 seconds.
Critical Rate increases by 0.0304 percentage points per Agility, up to 8.512% at 280 Agility.
Increases Critical DMG dealt to enemies affected by Soulbreak based on Critical Rate, up to 27% increase at 60% Critical Rate.

Increases Bamboocut Attack by 98-196.

During the Western Han, Hu Li led Mohist disciples into the Taihang Mountains to build a fortress, yet sheer cliffs surrounded them on all sides. To prevent fatal falls, Hu Li journeyed through the ranges for three months, enduring wind and frost, until he mastered eighteen climbing techniques from mountain dwellers.
He then fused these skills with Mohist mechanisms into a rope art he named "Skygrasp," symbolizing the ambition to not only grasp the mountain heights of Taihang, but to seize Heaven's very mandate on behalf of the people.

Increases the cap of Heaven's Will to 4 bars and initial Heaven's Will to 2 bars. Extends the duration of Heaven's Unity applied by Special Skill - Sky Grasped to 24 seconds. While Heaven's Unity is active, increases the amount of Heaven's Will earned through Falcon's Pursuit to 0.3 bars.
Critical Rate increases by 0.0304 percentage points per Agility, up to 8.512% at 280 Agility.
When there is more than 1 bar of Heaven's Will, increases Physical DMG and Bamboocut DMG based on Min Physical Attack during damage calculation, up to 9% increase at 750 Min Physical Attack.

Increases Bamboocut Attack by 98-196.
Bamboocut Penetration increases by 0.0672 per Min Bamboocut Attack, up to 22 at ≈327.381 Min Bamboocut Attack.

In her youth, as the leader of the Well of Heaven, Shen Hanying's unique blade art earned her the name "Frost Immortal." Thirty-two challengers fell before her icy resolve: her blade moved with the quiet depth of snow, the edge like morning frost glazing the world.
Though the moves—cleave, thrust, flick, sweep, slice—appear simple, they flow unseen and strike in an instant. You may block one, but the next is impossible to foresee. Wang Qing once marveled at Shen's blade: the first strike falls like silent snow; the second rages like a tempestuous blizzard.

The final blade flash of Snowparting Blade's Special Skill Treading Snow can interrupt enemies' Tenacity; in non-Arena modes, it also inflicts Dread, making targets more susceptible to stagger from hits. HP damage dealt to boss targets afflicted with your own Dread is increased by 12%. In non-Arena modes, hitting a target with General's Bane: Stab extends Dread's duration by 2s (or 6s against Multiplayer Mode Bosses).
Min Physical Attack increases by 0.264 per Agility, up to 73.92 at 280 Agility.
When Blade Momentum is higher than 1 bar, increases Critical DMG based on Critical Rate, up to 21% increase at 60% Critical Rate.

"I carry Heaven's Will, and by it, I make others yield."
The world believes Mohists favor the sword, yet few know they cherish the fist above all weapons. When Mozi founded his school, facing constant mockery, he reasoned with the reasonable and struck down the foolish. From this, a crude fist art emerged.
Though Mozi never meant to pass it down, disciples loved its simple power and used it to "enlighten" evildoers. Over generations, they refined it ceaselessly, even weaving in the striking force of hawks and falcons, transforming an ordinary style into something truly extraordinary.

Perfect Dodge's trigger window is extended, and you gain Tenacity in Arena modes or Invincibility in other modes during a Perfect Dodge. Upon triggering a Perfect Dodge, you recover a small amount of Endurance and can press Light Attack to cast Light Attack Varied Combo - Wicked Defiance. Heavy Attack Charged Skill - Vile Condemned series skills are guaranteed not to trigger Abrasion.

In the Inebriate state, Light Attacks from Skystrike Gauntlets become Bloombreak, and dodge is enhanced to Inebriate Dodge. In the Carouse state, triggering a Perfect Dodge restores 5 Binge points. This effect can occur at most once per second. In non-Arena modes, successfully triggering a Deflect also restores 5 Binge points. This effect can occur at most once per second.
Min Physical Attack increases by 0.264 per Agility, up to 73.92 at 280 Agility.
